content_sections.heading: ESIC Medical College Pune Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
ESIC Medical College Pune Vacancy 2026 Out
content_sections.text: ESIC Medical College & Hospital Pune has announced vacancies for teaching faculty and Senior Resident posts. The post-wise vacancy details are given below.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Medical College Pune Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for ESIC Medical College Pune Recruitment 2026 must fulfill the educational qualification and eligibility requirements prescribed by the National Medical Commission (NMC) guidelines. Educational qualification for Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor and Senior Resident posts will be as per National Medical Commission (NMC) guidelines.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Medical College Pune Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Age relaxation will be applicable as per Government of India rules.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Medical College Pune Salary Structure 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive consolidated remuneration as per ESIC Medical Administration guidelines and applicable Government of India pay rules.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Medical College Pune Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee should be paid through Demand Draft in favour of "ESI Fund A/c No.-1", payable at Pune.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ESIC Medical College Pune Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the official ESIC notification. Fill the application form with required details. Attach application fee Demand Draft, if applicable. Carry original documents and self-attested photocopies. Attend the walk-in interview at the scheduled venue.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Medical College Pune Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process will be based on performance in the walk-in interview conducted by the Selection Board. Application scrutiny Shortlisting (if required) Personal Interview Document Verification

content_sections.heading: Required Documents for Walk-in Interview
content_sections.text: Class 10th Certificate for Date of Birth proof MBBS Marks Sheets and Degree Certificate MD/MS/DNB/Postgraduate Degree Certificates, if applicable NMC/State Medical Council Registration Certificate Caste/EWS/PwBD Certificate, if applicable Experience Certificate Proof of Publications, if applicable Aadhaar Card Recent Passport Size Photograph NOC from current employer, if applicable

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applicants must appear with original documents and self-attested copies. Late candidates will not be allowed after the reporting time. Incomplete applications may be rejected. The appointment is purely contractual and does not provide any claim for regularization.

faq.question: Q1. When is the ESIC Medical College Pune Recruitment 2026 walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted from 07 September 2026 to 11 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ESIC Medical College Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 46 vacancies are available for Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor and Senior Resident posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for ESIC Pune Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 68 years for teaching faculty posts and 45 years for Senior Resident posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for ESIC Medical College Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on performance in the walk-in interview conducted by the Selection Board.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of ESIC Pune Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive remuneration according to their post, with approximate emoluments ranging from Rs. 1,50,000 to Rs. 2,57,000 per month.
